The source-checked orthoscheme sector ratio yields per-facet inequality after cone partition and a generic-center limit. The ordered-square change gives strict decrease and each derivative kink; direct gamma integration supplies the exact final branch. Explicit planar admissible trapezoids attain the subcritical bound and shrinking cube-corner truncations prove high-height geometric sharpness. The standard-library verifier passed 2,082 checks, corroborating but not replacing the infinite proof.
